infinite.options.title: Infinite
infinite.options.quality.tooltip: Presets for how far and sharp LoD's are. Pick custom to set detail yourself.
infinite.quality.mac.tooltip: 256 chunks, soft detail, with plant cutouts off.
infinite.quality.custom.tooltip: Set your own render distance and detail.
infinite.options.rendering.tooltip: Draws terrain past Minecraft's own view. Turn it off to keep recording terrain without drawing it.
infinite.options.detail.tooltip: How much of the screen one piece of terrain covers before it is split into finer pieces. Greater value = Better performance, lower quality. Lesser value = Worse performance, higher quality.
infinite.options.ambient_occlusion.toolt: Shades the creases and corners of distant terrain the way Minecraft's smooth lighting does.
infinite.options.anti_aliasing.tooltip: Smooths jagged edges and decreases shimmer in distant terrain by blending frames together.
infinite.options.smooth_border.tooltip: Adds a dissolve effect to the last few chunks of your distant terrain, so there is no hard line where it ends.
infinite.options.cave_culling.tooltip: Leaves the walls of underground caves out of coarse distant terrain. They can only be seen from inside a cave, so this saves memory and makes distant terrain build faster.
infinite.options.plant_cutouts.tooltip: When on, distant grass, flowers, seagrass and leaves show the gaps in their textures, increasing LoD detail at the expense of performance. When off each is drawn as a solid square, increasing performance at the expense of LoD detail.
infinite.options.earth_curvature.tooltip: Bends distant terrain down towards the horizon creating a round world effect. Greater value = Greater curve. Lesser value = Lesser curve.
infinite.options.nether_fog.tooltip: How thick the haze over the Nether's distant terrain gets. Off leaves the Nether clear, while 100% hides everything past where the fog has fully thickened.
infinite.options.nether_fog_start.toolti: How far from you the Nether's haze begins. It then thickens over the next 32 chunks.
infinite.options.ingest.tooltip: Turns chunks into distant terrain as they load. Turn it off to keep what you have without adding to it.
infinite.command.not_running: Infinite isn't running. Switch it on in its video settings first.
infinite.command.no_world: This world has no LoD's (they could not be opened, see the log).
infinite.command.bad_radius: Radius must be between %s and %s chunks.
infinite.command.refresh_failed: Infinite stopped and could not start again, see the log.
infinite.command.pregenerate.area_moved: The pregeneration that was running paused where it was.
infinite.command.pregenerate.started: Pregeneration started, check progress in boss bar.
infinite.command.pregenerate.stopped: Stopped pregenerating. The LoD's it made stay.
infinite.command.progress.already_shown: Progress is already shown in boss bar.
infinite.command.progress.already_hidden: Progress is already hidden from boss bar.
infinite.command.load.singleplayer_only: Loading saved terrain only works in singleplayer.
infinite.command.load.none_found: No saved terrain found to load.
